mood: A read we published has failed its own test. Better we find it than you do.
note: We test our own claims before anyone else gets the chance. INSUFFICIENT is an honest verdict and is reported as loudly as the others.

results.name: The Reprint Cycle
results.falsifier: a reprint-era product class stays below its pre-reprint level long enough that reprints are not absorbed
results.detail: needs a multi-week price series to judge absorption; we hold 24 clean days
results.needs: 30+ days of tape across a reprint event

results.name: Depth–Liquidity Matrix
results.falsifier: pile-up states precede 14-day price softness in fewer than 55% of cases

results.name: The Photo Premium
results.falsifier: the resting cross-market baseline measures at or below 0% — i.e. eBay stops carrying a premium at all

results.name: Commodity-Pack Venue Rule
results.falsifier: mapped TCGplayer pack prices persistently sit ABOVE eBay asks for the same SKU

results.name: Venue Boundary
results.falsifier: TCGplayer vintage-sealed volume becomes material — listing depth comparable to modern
results.detail: vintage depth 12 vs modern 56 — still a thinner, separate market

results.name: PSA-9 Tax / Fresh-Set Exception
results.falsifier: PSA 9s on established SWSH/SV chases return MORE than raw minus fees — i.e. grading a 9 is not a tax after all
results.detail: graded sale figures were withdrawn — they carry no time window, so they cannot be compared to a current raw price
results.needs: sold aggregates with an explicit date range

results.name: Scheduled-Event Anticlimax
results.falsifier: a rotation or print-close date produces a measurable same-week move across the affected cohort
results.detail: no scheduled event has fallen inside the clean window; first real test is the April 2027 rotation
results.needs: a scheduled event inside the tape

results.name: Supply Injection Absorb-or-Stall
results.falsifier: a supply injection is followed by neither absorption nor a stall — listings rise and prices are unaffected either way
results.detail: 100% of 4 supply injections moved prices less than 1% — injections are not being absorbed OR stalling, which is the stated kill condition

results.name: Artist Cohort Attribution
results.falsifier: cards by the same illustrator move together no more often than random cards of similar rarity and era
results.detail: needs the full catalogue ingested plus 30+ days of singles history to compare cohort coherence against a random baseline

results.name: Reprint Pressure
results.falsifier: late-print sets with filling shelves are no more likely to see a reprint announced within 90 days than late-print sets generally
results.detail: 2 crossings today (2 arriving, 0 closing) — but the falsifier needs 90 days of reprint announcements to compare against, which we do not yet log
results.needs: a log of reprint announcements, and 90 days of these crossings to test them against

results.name: Index moves only on the market
results.falsifier: the index level changes on a day when composition or pricing basis changed
results.detail: 176 products carried the day's move; 1 entered or lacked a prior price and correctly contributed nothing

amendmentsDrafted.draft: RT-2 (Supply Injection Absorb-or-Stall) tripped its own falsifier on 2026-10-15: 100% of 4 supply injections moved prices less than 1% — injections are not being absorbed OR stalling, which is the stated kill condition We stated in advance that this would end the thesis, so it ends. A replacement read will not be published until it carries its own falsifier.
